gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed high-grade glioma (WHO classification grade III or IV)
Part II: Patients with histological or cytological diagnosis of glioblastoma according to World Health Organization (WHO) classification (2021)

candidate_evidence.quote: HX301 is an investigational drug that has not yet been approved by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) or any other regulatory authorities for commercial purposes.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients with recurrent or progressive clinically assessed disease according to RANO criteria with evaluable lesions
who received surgical treatment for the first time and standard concurrent chemoradiotherapy

role_evidence.quote: HX301 will be administered in combination with temozolomide approximately 4-6 weeks after completion of chemoradiotherapy.

coder_notes: HX301 and temozolomide are registered as one combined intervention ('HX301+/Temozolomide'), so both rows carry that name. Part I is HX301 monotherapy in high-grade glioma (grade III/IV), Part II is HX301 + temozolomide after chemoradiation in glioblastoma; trial-level regimen coded combination because of the temozolomide in Part II. Glioblastoma is named in the Part II inclusion criterion. No molecular biomarker is required.
